ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

color.note: Neutral keeps docs and dense headers quiet. It only swaps the indicator, the active text, and the active background.

tabs.description: Tab component for organizing content into switchable panels.

future-editable.text: Editable Tabs (close, rename, reorder, "..." action menu) will be implemented after the Dropdown Menu component is complete. The current Tabs architecture is prepared for this future extension with stable value tracking, metadata, icon, badge, and disabled support.
future-editable.title: Editable Tabs

manual-activation.instruction: Use Arrow keys to move focus, Enter/Space to activate.
manual-activation.panel-step-1: Step 1 content. Focus another tab and press Enter to switch.
manual-activation.panel-step-2: Step 2 content. Manual activation allows reviewing tabs first.

reduced-motion.text: All tab content transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and the `[data-reduced-motion]` attribute. When reduced motion is preferred, fade and slide animations are disabled, falling back to instant content switching without animation.

transition-slide.panel-first: First panel — slides in from right when coming from left.
transition-slide.panel-second: Second panel — slides in from right or left.
transition-slide.panel-third: Third panel — slides in from left when coming from right.

with-panels.panel-actions: Actions content panel. View CI/CD pipeline status.
with-panels.panel-code: Code content panel. Write and review your code here.
with-panels.panel-issues: Issues content panel. Track and manage issues.
with-panels.panel-pull-requests: Pull requests content panel. Review open PRs.

examples.note: Start with the default tabs, then explore appearances and variants below.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

size-density.note: Size and density work together in the component. Combine all three controls to see every combination.
